tagline: One of the world's leading providers of communications, technology, information and streaming products and services
hero_kpi_rationale: The Consumer segment represents 77% of total revenue and is the primary growth driver, fueled by 5G, fiber and fixed wireless access (FWA), making it the key KPI despite the absence of a significant technological wow factor.

kpis.name: Consumer Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from individual customers through mobile, fiber and fixed wireless internet access.
kpis.description: The Consumer segment grew revenue by 3.8% in 2025, driven by 5G adoption, FWA expansion and fiber network growth.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by 5G and fiber

kpis.name: Business Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from enterprise services, including IoT connectivity, private networks and security.
kpis.description: The Business segment declined by 1.6% in 2025, reflecting enterprise spending pressures and increased competition.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (capex)
kpis.explanation: Annual spending to develop and maintain networks, particularly fiber and 5G.
kpis.description: Verizon invested $17 billion in 2025 to strengthen its fiber and wireless networks, preparing for future connectivity demand.
kpis.signal: Sustained high level to enhance network coverage

kpis.name: Wireless Connections (total)
kpis.explanation: Total number of mobile lines for consumers and businesses, including FWA.
kpis.description: Verizon had 116 million consumer wireless connections and 31 million business connections as of December 31, 2025, totaling 147 million.
kpis.signal: Massive customer base in the U.S. market

kpis.name: Fixed Broadband Connections
kpis.explanation: Total number of households and businesses subscribed to fixed internet (fiber, FWA, DSL).
kpis.description: Verizon had 11 million consumer and 3 million business fixed broadband connections as of December 31, 2025, totaling 14 million.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth via fiber and FWA

kpis.name: Postpaid Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of mobile lines billed after usage, indicating customer quality.
kpis.description: 83% of consumer wireless connections are postpaid, reflecting an engaged and more profitable customer base.

kpis.name: Fiber Network Expansion
kpis.explanation: Number of U.S. states covered by Verizon's 100% fiber-optic network.
kpis.description: Verizon expanded its fiber network to 31 U.S. states and Washington D.C. by end of 2025, including through the acquisition of Frontier.

kpis.name: AI and Cloud Networks
kpis.explanation: Use of AI and cloud to virtualize and optimize networks.
kpis.description: Verizon leverages AI, automation and cloud to improve network performance and efficiency, including through infrastructure virtualization.
kpis.signal: Strategic integration of AI into networks

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $138.191 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 declared fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $17.174 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a rapidly evolving market with aggressive competitors. Verizon's position in the telecommunications market is threatened by new entrants and technological innovations.

risks.title: Capital Expenditures
risks.score_rationale: Verizon's capital expenditures are significant, at $17 billion in 2025. This could weigh on the company's liquidity and limit its investment capacity.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The telecommunications sector is subject to strict regulations. Changes in laws and regulations could impact Verizon's operations and revenues.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity threats are constantly evolving and could impact Verizon's systems and data. A security breach could have serious consequences for the company.

risks.title: Debt
risks.score_rationale: Verizon has significant debt, at $147 billion in 2025. This could weigh on the company's liquidity and limit its investment capacity.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: Verizon relies heavily on technology for its operations. Technical issues or outages could impact the company's services and revenues.

risks.title: Climate Change
risks.score_rationale: Climate change could impact Verizon's infrastructure and operations. However, the impact is difficult to assess and could be limited.

ai_positioning.summary: Company VZ does not mention artificial intelligence significantly in its report.
